# Plugin Guide Coupling Notes

## Surface registry — one roster, three projections

**Invariant:** `SURFACE_GROUPS` in `plugins/plugin-guide/src/surfaces.ts` is the single source of truth for plugin surfaces.

**Why:** App, website, and SDK reference must show identical surface slots. App mounts `ProductMap` from the same registry; public website renders from `website/lib/plugin-guide/` (generated by `website/scripts/sync-plugin-guide.mjs` from surfaces.ts, served at `/extensions`); SDK reference lists same groups in `docs/extensions-sdk-reference.md` (synced to `/docs/extensions-sdk-reference/`).

**Guard:** `plugins/plugin-guide/src/api-sync.test.ts` — asserts the SDK reference lists every group/surface and the website map is identical to plugin sources.

**When changing:**
- Add a surface slot = add Plugin Guide card + SDK-reference heading/bullet + run `website/scripts/sync-plugin-guide.mjs` (regenerates website/lib/plugin-guide/).
- Do NOT hand-edit `website/lib/plugin-guide/` — script overwrites it.
